entry.title: What our first agent evals caught in one day
entry.summary: LibSync is a $0/month library-assistant agent: PydanticAI on Groq's free tier, with Pinecone for policy retrieval and Open Library, OpenAlex and Crossref as its tools. By Tier 6 it had 100+ unit tests
